name: pqc_vendor_class
description: What kind of vendor or dependency a PQC vendor claim is about.

definitions.provider: A crypto provider or toolchain (e.g. OpenSSL, Go, a JDK).
definitions.library: A crypto library that packages depend on.
definitions.ecosystem: A signing or identity ecosystem (e.g. Sigstore, GnuPG, Kerberos).
definitions.service: A hosted service the fleet calls.

standard.none: Project-defined vocabulary for curated vendor PQC claims.
